41b9d3d0f42d3faa.description:
SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role.
We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly.
As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch.
Key responsibilities

• 
Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS

• 
Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse

• 
Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools

• 
Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager

• 
Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on)

• 
Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along

Qualifications and skills
• 
You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working.
Required skills

• 
WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one.

• 
HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates.

• 
Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site.

• 
APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack.

• 
Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues.

• 
Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t.

• 
Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack.

• 
Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision.

Nice-to-have skills

• 
Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure.

• 
PHP development experience.

• 
Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients.

• 
Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices.

• 
Experience with Git and version control.

What success looks like
Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences.

• 
Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot.

• 
Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality.

• 
Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact.

• 
Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows.

• 
Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early.

• 
Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack.

Originally posted on Himalayas

41cda36898b33250.description:
About the team
Sarvam builds Indic-language AI used at population scale. The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through.
The team builds and runs what it builds. Engineers own real systems end to end, and every repeated piece of manual work is a candidate for automation. As an AI company, we are building AI agents into our own operations, to plan and review infrastructure changes, triage alerts and handle routine issues, with engineers setting the guardrails.
About the role
You keep the infrastructure behind Sarvam’s products running. You handle day-to-day operations — deployments, provisioning, access, incidents and cost questions — and you are expected to automate that work away.
We hire for one instinct above everything else: you notice something done by hand every day, ask why it can’t run itself, and build the thing that removes it — a script, a pipeline step, a bot, a small Kubernetes operator, or an AI agent that does the work. Operations is a large part of this role, and it is where you find what is worth automating.
As you automate your own toil away, more of your time goes into platform and automation work.
Products you may work on
Sarvam builds across a broad range of AI products: voice agents, coding agents, coworker agents, dubbing, our API platform, and the real-time voice and WebRTC infrastructure underneath them, among many others. You will work on the infrastructure behind them.
Responsibilities
• Own infrastructure operations across Sarvam’s products: deployments, provisioning requests, access, environment issues, cost questions
• Respond to incidents, write the runbook or postmortem afterwards, and fix the cause
• Automate repeated work: turn manual steps into pipeline jobs, Terraform modules, templates or self-service for product teams
• Build AI-assisted automations: agents that triage alerts, summarise incidents, review routine changes or answer product teams’ infrastructure questions, with a human approving anything risky
• Security basics: keep images and dependencies patched, rotate credentials, keep secrets out of code, fix security findings
• Reliability basics: keep dashboards and alerts accurate, track SLOs and cost, delete noisy alerts
• Take part in on-call
Requirements
• 2–5 years in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure or backend engineering
• Has built infrastructure outside a ticket: a homelab, an open-source contribution, a side project, or an internal tool nobody asked for — and can show the code (GitHub, a blog post or a demo)
• Comfortable on the Linux command line: processes, networking basics, logs, systemd
• Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; has deployed and debugged something running on a cluster
• Scripting in Python, Go or Bash
• Basic Git and CI/CD experience
• Has spotted a repeated manual task — a daily review, a recurring fix, a routine request — and built something that removed it: a script, a CI job, a bot or a Kubernetes operator. You can walk us through what you noticed, why it mattered, what you built and what it saved
• Has used LLMs or AI agents to automate real work, not only for writing code
• Fixes causes rather than the same symptom twice; asks “why is this manual?” before doing it again
• Curious, takes ownership, wants to grow into platform engineering
• Nice to have: Terraform, a public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), Prometheus / Grafana, exposure to SIP, WebRTC or real-time media, any cloud or Kubernetes certification

412e63bfd8a440ae.description: We are hiring a competitive Data Engineer to join our vibrant team at Hexaconcepts in Noida. Growing your career as a Full Time Data Engineer is a great opportunity to develop excellent skills. If you are robust in persuasion, planning and have the right drive for the job, then apply for the position of Data Engineer at Hexaconcepts today! The Company : A data-sciences company, serving clients across industries across geographies. A fast growing organisation witnessing huge demand for their services, covering Business Intelligence, Data warehousing, Data engineering and Predictive analytics (AI/ML). On this growth trajectory, they are looking to onboard smart data science and data engineering professionals across all areas of data-sciences. Position: Data Engineer Relevant experience: 4 to 8 years Job-location: Noida Joining: Immediate to 30 days Job Description In a client-project environment, a data engineer will be responsible for converting raw data into usable information for analytics and business decision-making. He/she will work with various systems that can be found everywhere (i.e., multiple industries). So, knowledge and exposure of best practices will be critical. A Data Engineer will be expected to use different technologies to collect and map an organizations data landscape to help decision-makers find cost savings and optimization opportunities. Elementwise, a project may involve building data-pipeline or maintaining the existing set-up or even building or setting up entire data-lake. The Data engineer will be directly working with the client, so looking for a good individual contributor and a great team-player a combination holding the key to successful delivery of the project. Responsibilities: a) Analyse and organize raw data from different sources b) Build data systems and pipelines c) Evaluate business needs and objectives d) Prepare data for prescriptive and predictive modelling e) Build algorithms and prototypes f) Explore ways to enhance data quality and reliability g) Identify opportunities for data acquisition h) Collaborate with data scientists and architects on several projects Requirements and skills: a) Extensive exposure to at least 1 of these environments viz. AWS or GCP b) Previous experience as a data engineer or in a similar role c) Technical expertise with data models, data mining, and segmentation techniques d) Knowledge of programming languages (e.g. Java and Python) e) Hands-on experience with SQL database design f) Degree in Computer Science, IT, or similar field g) Data engineering certification (e.g IBM Certified Data Engineer) is a plus Benefits of working as a Data Engineer in Noida: Learning opportunities Opportunities to grow Market-competitive salary .

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
About the role
You’ll be a Strategic AE owning a focused set of Life Sciences accounts. You’ll run end-to-end deals from first technical champion through security, vendor risk, procurement, and rollout, partnering closely with Solutions Engineering and Product to prove value in real workflows.

What you’ll do
• 
Own a small portfolio of strategic LS accounts and a net-new target list
• 
Build multi-threaded relationships across Eng/Platform, Security, Risk, and Procurement
• 
Run consultative discovery and build ROI cases tied to developer productivity + risk reduction
• 
Drive evaluations/POVs (SSO/SCIM, auditability, data handling, policy controls)
• 
Navigate vendor risk, legal, and enterprise procurement to close and deploy
• 
Land and expand: initial team → org standardization → multi-business-unit rollout
• 
Feed customer signal back to Product/GTM and help refine repeatable playbooks

You may be a fit if
• 
You have 10+ years closing enterprise software deals with consistent quota attainment
• 
You have experience selling into Life Sciences (or deeply regulated enterprise environments)
• 
You are comfortable with technical buyers and security stakeholders; you can earn engineering trust
• 
You're a true hunter - you proactively build pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, creative sourcing, and relentless follow-up, rather than relying on inbound demand
• 
You have strong outbound + pipeline discipline; accurate forecasting and crisp written communication
• 
You thrive as an IC in a flat org: high ownership, low ego, fast learning loop
